text: The exterior derivative d(P dx + Q dy) = (∂Q/∂x - ∂P/∂y) dx∧dy is definitionally equal to the classical curl formula — no proof required, just unfolding definitions.

Whitney's theorem (greens_theorem_l1curl) is restated in Stokes form ∫_C ω = ∫_D dω, making the connection to exterior calculus explicit. The proof is a direct application of the axiom with terminology translation.
The L¹ closure condition dω = 0 a.e. is the coordinate-free version of ∂Q/∂x = ∂P/∂y a.e. Cauchy-Goursat generalizes: any conservative L¹ field has zero circulation on Lipschitz loops.
Continuity of the curl (C¹ condition) immediately gives L¹ integrability via continuousOn.integrableOn_compact — this one-line proof shows why the smooth case is automatic under Whitney's framework.
The hierarchy OQ-01 ⊂ C¹-Whitney ⊂ L¹-Whitney establishes that Whitney's axiom is a genuine extension: it proves new results (Lipschitz boundary + L¹ curl) not reachable by OQ-01's FTC approach.
